title: World Trail Majors — RACES list
claims: The World Trail Majors race list includes Mt.FUJI 100 among its races with the dates 2026/04/24-26.
The World Trail Majors description says Mt.FUJI100 connects the approximately 100 miles of trails at the foot of Mt. Fuji with the people and culture associated with them.
The same description says the race requires no sleep or rest, and that it aims to convey the importance of taking on challenges and the appeal of trail running.

The list shown on 2026-11-08 contains ten World Trail Majors races: Hong Kong 100, Black Canyon Ultras, Transgrancanaria, Mt.FUJI 100, MIUT Madeira, South Downs Way 100, Quebec Mega Trail, Vietnam Mountain Marathon, Grampians Peaks Trail 100 Miler and RMB Ultra-Trail Cape Town.
The list shows 2026 dates and does not state whether Mt.FUJI 100 is in the series for 2027.
